message.content: {"summary":"You present a relevant Australian reef-monitoring mission, identify scientific and conservation users, and provide a feasible high-level schedule with useful sources. To reach the next rubric level, make the mission measurable and technically justified, include preliminary engineering results, and strengthen the plan with specific outputs and contingencies. Your report is clearly structured, but references and some presentation details need refinement.","next_steps":["In Mission Concept & Rationale, define measurable objectives and requirements: payload and spectral bands, spatial resolution, revisit interval, coverage, and data-delivery time. Explain how these serve your users, and qualify the bleaching rationale by distinguishing thermal stress from ocean acidification’s effects on coral calcification.","In Project Plan & Preliminary Progress, add engineering results rather than only scheduling future work: compare candidate orbits and coverage, document launch/orbit assumptions, and include an STK simulation or calculation with a brief interpretation. Give each Gantt task a clear output, explain its link to the mission, and identify contingency actions if a task slips or assumptions change.","For the next presentation level, replace raw links and numbered citations with a consistent reference list that matches in-text citations. Explain the Gantt chart’s grey cells and review wording for precision; retain the clear headings and labelled chart."],"criteria":{"C1":"Your Mission Concept & Rationale identifies Australian benefit, scientists and conservation users, and a potential monitoring function. To reach Accomplished, specify measurable objectives and payload, coverage, revisit, resolution, and timeliness requirements; qualify the acidification–bleaching claim.","C2":"Your Project Plan & Preliminary Progress includes a readable timetable, task descriptions, planned sources, and STK. To reach Accomplished, add mission-specific justification, concrete outputs for tasks, and contingencies or variations that keep the work feasible.","C3":"Your research into monitoring systems and coral bleaching, plus completion of STK tutorials, shows initial activity. To reach the next level, include and interpret preliminary design results, such as orbit/coverage analysis, calculations, or simulation outputs.","C4":"Your report has clear headings, logical order, and a legible labelled Gantt chart. To reach Accomplished, use a consistent formal reference list matching citations, clarify the grey cells, and polish imprecise wording and formatting."}}
